description: Independently review supplied CUDA sources and actual trajectories for a block-local adaptive integrator. Assess timestamped physical events, rejected private updates, and whether independent neuron blocks remain independent until the declared coupling boundary. No scientific acceptance by routing.

Repair and verify a concrete local serialization defect: cold reconstruction loses effective tau/theta arrays. Preserve exact declared host and GPU operator values without reapplying interventions, compare continuous/cold/failure paths, retain failed body sessions as failed.

Determine mathematically whether an affine event-response propagator can replace global event-aligned integration in a recurrent nonlinear brain. Derive receiver and recurrent-error bounds or retain fallback; do not infer compatibility or speed from an isolated linear fixture.
